// Module
var code = `<h1>Current character-card settings</h1> <p>Some character cards are designed to work alongside other frameworks or include a custom front end. They therefore require a predefined set of MVU settings so that workflows such as extra-model parsing use the intended update method and world-book entries.</p> <p>Any non-regex setting explicitly configured here overrides the corresponding user setting; settings set to <strong>Inherit user settings</strong> do not. The character card's world-book entry whitelist and blacklist regexes are combined with the rules in the user settings: an entry passes the whitelist if it matches any configured whitelist rule, and is excluded if it matches any configured blacklist rule.</p> <p>For example, if <strong>Automatic requests</strong> is set to <strong>Disabled</strong> in the character-card settings, MVU will not start extra-model parsing automatically after an AI reply is received, regardless of the user's setting for this option. You can still run it manually with <strong>Retry extra-model parsing</strong>.</p> <p>The whitelist and blacklist affect world-book entries only in extra-model parsing requests. For blacklist regexes, an entry subject to filtering is excluded when its <code>comment</code> matches either the user's rule or the character card's rule. Entries marked <code>[mvu_update]</code> bypass whitelist and blacklist filtering.</p> `;
// Exports
export default code;
