// Module
var code = `<h1>Variable update method</h1> <p>Choose how variables are updated so the story model can focus on writing the story.</p> <h2>Alongside AI output</h2> <p>World-book entries are sent to the AI through SillyTavern's normal flow. The AI includes variable-update analysis and commands in its reply, and MVU applies those updates.</p> <h2>Extra-model parsing</h2> <p>This method splits the request: one AI writes the story, then another AI analyzes that story and updates the variables.</p> <p>To separate the two tasks, MVU filters world-book entries before sending them through SillyTavern's normal flow:</p> <ul> <li>Entries whose names contain <code>[mvu_plot]</code> are sent only to the story AI.</li> <li>Entries whose names contain <code>[mvu_update]</code> are sent only to the variable-update AI.</li> <li>Entries containing neither <code>[mvu_plot]</code> nor <code>[mvu_update]</code> are sent to both AIs.</li> </ul> <p>An MVU character card therefore needs <code>[mvu_plot]</code> or <code>[mvu_update]</code> in its world-book entry names to support extra-model parsing.</p> <p>Cards made with the latest <a href="https://stagedog.github.io/%E7%BB%9C%E7%BB%9C/%E6%95%99%E7%A8%8B/%E6%89%8B%E5%86%99mvu%E5%8F%98%E9%87%8F%E5%8D%A1/">MVU tutorial</a> support extra-model parsing directly. You can also use that tutorial to adapt older cards.</p> `;
// Exports
export default code;
